original_review.key_result: Bare route_id plus active_chunk_id succeeded in cold case 001: the assistant accepted desk-reset-v0 / clear_trash as active route state and, on move_on, advanced exactly one chunk to collect_dishes. Label support also passed, route_id-only held, active_chunk_id-only semantically held with a scorer-label caveat, wrong next_chunk_id was ignored when active authority existed, wrong-next without active_chunk_id held, damaged allowed_intents missing move_on blocked movement, and explicit legal_successor sanity passed.
original_review.language_lesson: Within the current TTD_COMMAND_V1 packet envelope, the smallest proven route-law carrier is route_id plus active_chunk_id. active_chunk_label, commit_policy, activation_frame, next_chunk_id, allowed_intents, and legal_successor_chunk_id are not required for basic clear_trash to collect_dishes movement, although allowed_intents can still veto movement when present and damaged. next_chunk_id remains non-authoritative when active_chunk_id is present.

pointer_update.purpose: Now that route_id plus active_chunk_id is proven as the minimum carrier inside the current TTD_COMMAND_V1 envelope, isolate which remaining protocol scaffolding makes the stripped packet behave as active route state rather than plain text.
evidence_reviewed: case 001: route_id plus active_chunk_id only advanced clear_trash to collect_dishes in fresh context
case 002: adding active_chunk_label also advanced to collect_dishes without commit_policy or activation_frame
case 003: route_id alone held with No active chunk provided
case 004: active_chunk_id alone semantically held with No route_id provided, though the heuristic classified it as FAIL_LOST_ROUTE
case 005: wrong next_chunk_id stack_papers was ignored when route_id and active_chunk_id were present
case 006: route_id plus wrong next_chunk_id held when active_chunk_id was missing
case 007: allowed_intents missing move_on blocked advancement
case 008: explicit legal_successor sanity advanced to collect_dishes
pointer_update.open_gap: The carrier-isolation family is satisfied for route_id plus active_chunk_id inside the current packet envelope. The remaining uncertainty is whether success depends on protocol scaffolding such as the TTD_COMMAND_V1 header line, the JSON protocol field, command_id presence, or other activation-frame language.
pointer_update.test_strategy: Generate a validator-ready 8-case suite focused on protocol activation-frame ablation around the now-proven route_id plus active_chunk_id carrier. Keep route_sequence hidden. Use a fresh disposable ChatGPT tab. Preserve a known-good route_id plus active_chunk_id baseline, then vary protocol field presence, command_id presence, packet interpretation wording, activation_frame wording, and explicit sanity control while staying within runner-supported packet strings.
avoid: Do not retest label as the main question
Do not let next_chunk_id become authority
Do not include legal_successor_chunk_id before the final sanity control
Do not treat the case 004 heuristic FAIL_LOST_ROUTE as a language failure without noting the assistant correctly held because route_id was missing
pointer_update.suite_shape_recommendation: Use a validator-ready 8-case protocol-scaffolding ablation suite. Case 001 should be the known-good route_id plus active_chunk_id carrier baseline. Follow with controlled removals or additions of protocol/key/command/activation wording, a missing-field negative control, a wrong-next authority control, a damaged-intents control, and a final explicit legal_successor sanity case.
pointer_update.retirement_condition: Retire this next pointer when the run shows which protocol scaffolding is required around route_id plus active_chunk_id, whether command_id/protocol fields are merely bookkeeping or actual activation cues, and whether the known-good carrier still ignores wrong-next traps and respects damaged allowed_intents.
pointer_update.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Generate route_law_protocol_activation_frame_ablation_route_active_carrier_8case_v1 as a validator-ready 8-case suite using route_id plus active_chunk_id as the known-good carrier baseline and testing the remaining protocol activation-frame scaffolding.
